--au-slider-track-paint: Optional data-derived channel background; ordinary sliders retain the theme track and fill.
--au-slider-progress-paint: Optional progress overlay paint for data-channel sliders; transparent preserves the full channel background in Firefox.
--au-accordion-indent: Accordion content indentation override; falls back to shared spacing.
--au-accordion-pad-x: Accordion horizontal padding override; falls back to shared spacing.
--au-accordion-row: Accordion row height override; falls back to shared spacing.
--au-scroll-fade-size: Scroll-area local fade length override; zero disables fading.
--au-tab-height: Tab strip local height override; falls back to row height.
--au-tab-max-width: Tab bar measurement output consumed by tab cells.
--au-tree-font: Tree typography override; defaults supplied by the component.
--au-tree-guide-opacity: Tree container hover-state input controlling indentation guides.
--au-tree-item-selected: Generic tree item selection fill override.
--au-tree-level: Tree row level property bridge used in indentation calculation.
--au-nesting-header-height: Host nesting preference input: reserves wrapper header space while expanded; absent follows the local gutter hover.
--au-nesting-row-opacity: Host nesting preference input: keeps wrapper labels visible while expanded; absent follows local hover.
--au-nesting-row-events: Host nesting preference input: enables wrapper controls while expanded; absent follows local hover.
